## Description

Combines Koopman operator linear embedding dictionaries with Model Predictive Control within a Wasserstein distributionally robust optimization framework to stabilize multi-period portfolio control under model error.

## Where it may fit

Multi-period asset allocation during severe macroeconomic structural breaks and model misspecification.

## Vehicles

Global Macro Hedge Funds, Quantitative Asset Allocation Desks.

## Required data

Multi-asset historical return series, macroeconomic indicator panels, volatility covariance tensors.

## Caveats

Koopman observable dictionary expansion combined with robust conic optimization increases computational latency.
